evals.prompt: Draft a non-profit charter supremacy and severability clause at Sovereign register.
evals.expected_output: Use Sovereign legislative register ('shall' for obligations and declared effects, 'may' for permissions), ordered list structure with blank-line spacing, definitions as 'A Term is ...', and hostile-reading audit.
expectations: Uses 'shall' for legislative obligations and declared effects
Uses sovereign-core severability rather than ordinary prescriptive severability
Avoids synonym stacking and bare present tense for legal effects

evals.prompt: Audit an existing employee IT security policy (prescriptive instrument) for modal drift.
evals.expected_output: Check that obligations use 'must', scope/declared effects use 'will', permissions use 'may', and 'shall' is flagged outside verbatim quotations.
expectations: Preserves user-supplied structure and locked wording
